versos.hebraico: הוֹד֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה קִרְא֣וּ בִּשְׁמ֑וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִילוֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
controles.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
controles.livre: Agradecei ao SENHOR, chamai o seu nome; anunciai suas obras entre os povos.

versos.hebraico: שִֽׁירוּ־ל֭וֹ זַמְּרוּ־ל֑וֹ שִׂ֝֗יחוּ בְּכָל־נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
controles.kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
controles.livre: Cantai a ele, tocai músicas para ele; falai de todas as suas maravilhas.

versos.hebraico: הִֽ֭תְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח לֵ֤ב׀ מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
controles.kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.
controles.livre: Tende orgulho de seu santo nome; alegre-se o coração dos que buscam ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: דִּרְשׁ֣וּ יְהוָ֣ה וְעֻזּ֑וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֖וּ פָנָ֣יו תָּמִֽיד׃

controles.web: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
controles.kjv: Seek the Lord, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
controles.livre: Buscai ao SENHOR e à sua força; buscai a presença dele continuamente.

versos.hebraico: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתָ֥יו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֑ה מֹ֝פְתָ֗יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִֽיו׃

controles.web: Remember his marvelous works that he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
controles.kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
controles.livre: Lembrai-vos de suas maravilhas, que ele fez; de seus milagres, e dos juízos de sua boca.

versos.hebraico: זֶ֭רַע אַבְרָהָ֣ם עַבְדּ֑וֹ בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּחִירָֽיו׃

controles.web: you seed of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
controles.kjv: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
controles.livre: Vós, que sois da semente de seu servo Abraão; vós, filhos de Jacó, seus escolhidos.

versos.hebraico: ה֭וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ בְּכָל־הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו׃

controles.web: He is Yahweh, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
controles.kjv: He is the Lord our God: his judgments are in all the earth.
controles.livre: Ele é o SENHOR, nosso Deus; seus juízos estão em toda a terra.

versos.hebraico: זָכַ֣ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִ֝וָּ֗ה לְאֶ֣לֶף דּֽוֹר׃

controles.web: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
controles.kjv: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
controles.livre: Ele se lembra para sempre de seu pacto, da palavra que ele mandou até mil gerações;

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּ֭רַת אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֑ם וּשְׁב֖וּעָת֣וֹ לְיִשְׂחָֽק׃

controles.web: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,
controles.kjv: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
controles.livre: O qual ele firmou com Abraão, e de seu juramento a Isaque.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּֽעֲמִידֶ֣הָ לְיַעֲקֹ֣ב לְחֹ֑ק לְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: and confirmed the same to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
controles.kjv: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
controles.livre: O qual também confirmou a Jacó como estatuto, a Israel como pacto eterno.

versos.hebraico: לֵאמֹ֗ר לְךָ֗ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת־אֶֽרֶץ־כְּנָ֑עַן חֶ֝֗בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance”;
controles.kjv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
controles.livre: Dizendo: A ti darei a terra de Canaã, a porção de vossa herança.

versos.hebraico: בִּֽ֭הְיוֹתָם מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
controles.kjv: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
controles.livre: Sendo eles poucos em número; eram poucos, e estrangeiros nela.

versos.hebraico: וַֽ֭יִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל־גּ֑וֹי מִ֝מַּמְלָכָ֗ה אֶל־עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃

controles.web: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
controles.kjv: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
controles.livre: E andaram de nação em nação, de um reino a outro povo.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־הִנִּ֣יחַ אָדָ֣ם לְעָשְׁקָ֑ם וַיּ֖וֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מְלָכִֽים׃

controles.web: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
controles.kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
controles.livre: Ele não permitiu a ninguém que os oprimisse; e por causa deles repreendeu a reis,

versos.hebraico: אַֽל־תִּגְּע֥וּ בִמְשִׁיחָ֑י וְ֝לִנְבִיאַי אַל־תָּרֵֽעוּ׃

controles.web: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
controles.kjv: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
controles.livre: Dizendo : Não toqueis nos meus ungidos, e não façais mal a meus profetas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֣א רָ֭עָב עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ כָּֽל־מַטֵּה־לֶ֥חֶם שָׁבָֽר׃

controles.web: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
controles.kjv: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
controles.livre: E chamou a fome sobre a terra; ele interrompeu toda fonte de alimento;

versos.hebraico: שָׁלַ֣ח לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם אִ֑ישׁ לְ֝עֶ֗בֶד נִמְכַּ֥ר יוֹסֵֽף׃

controles.web: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
controles.kjv: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
controles.livre: Enviou um homem adiante deles: José, que foi vendido como escravo.

versos.hebraico: עִנּ֣וּ בַכֶּ֣בֶל רגליו בַּ֝רְזֶ֗ל בָּ֣אָה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

controles.web: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
controles.kjv: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
controles.livre: Amarraram seus pés em correntes; ele foi preso com ferros;

versos.hebraico: עַד־עֵ֥ת בֹּֽא־דְבָר֑וֹ אִמְרַ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה צְרָפָֽתְהוּ׃

controles.web: until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh’s word proved him true.
controles.kjv: Until the time that his word came: the word of the Lord tried him.
controles.livre: Até o tempo que sua mensagem chegou, a palavra do SENHOR provou o valor que ele tinha.

versos.hebraico: שָׁ֣לַח מֶ֭לֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵ֑הוּ מֹשֵׁ֥ל עַ֝מִּ֗ים וַֽיְפַתְּחֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: The king sent and freed him; even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
controles.kjv: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
controles.livre: O rei mandou que ele fosse solto; o governante de povos o libertou.

versos.hebraico: שָׂמ֣וֹ אָד֣וֹן לְבֵית֑וֹ וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בְּכָל־קִנְיָנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions;
controles.kjv: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
controles.livre: Ele o pôs como senhor de sua casa, e por chefe de todos os seus bens,

versos.hebraico: לֶאְסֹ֣ר שָׂרָ֣יו בְּנַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּזְקֵנָ֥יו יְחַכֵּֽם׃

controles.web: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
controles.kjv: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
controles.livre: Para dar ordens a suas autoridades, e instruir a seus anciãos.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ֝יַעֲקֹ֗ב גָּ֣ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־חָֽם׃

controles.web: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
controles.kjv: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
controles.livre: Então Israel entrou no Egito; Jacó peregrinou na terra de Cam.

versos.hebraico: וַיֶּ֣פֶר אֶת־עַמּ֣וֹ מְאֹ֑ד וַ֝יַּֽעֲצִמֵהוּ מִצָּרָֽיו׃

controles.web: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
controles.kjv: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
controles.livre: E fez seu povo crescer muito, e o fez mais poderoso que seus adversários.

versos.hebraico: הָפַ֣ךְ לִ֭בָּם לִשְׂנֹ֣א עַמּ֑וֹ לְ֝הִתְנַכֵּ֗ל בַּעֲבָדָֽיו׃

controles.web: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
controles.kjv: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
controles.livre: E mudou o coração dos outros ,para que odiassem ao seu povo, para que tratassem mal a seus servos.

versos.hebraico: שָׁ֭לַח מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֑וֹ אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽחַר־בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
controles.kjv: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
controles.livre: Então enviou seu servo Moisés, e a Arão, a quem tinha escolhido;

versos.hebraico: שָֽׂמוּ־בָ֭ם דִּבְרֵ֣י אֹתוֹתָ֑יו וּ֝מֹפְתִ֗ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָֽם׃

controles.web: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
controles.kjv: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
controles.livre: Que fizeram entre eles os sinais anunciados, e coisas sobrenaturais na terra de Cam.

versos.hebraico: שָׁ֣לַֽח חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וַיַּחְשִׁ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא־מָ֝ר֗וּ אֶת־דברוו׃

controles.web: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
controles.kjv: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
controles.livre: Ele mandou trevas, e fez escurecer; e não foram rebeldes a sua palavra.

versos.hebraico: הָפַ֣ךְ אֶת־מֵימֵיהֶ֣ם לְדָ֑ם וַ֝יָּ֗מֶת אֶת־דְּגָתָֽם׃

controles.web: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
controles.kjv: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
controles.livre: Ele transformou suas águas em sangue, e matou a seus peixes.

versos.hebraico: שָׁרַ֣ץ אַרְצָ֣ם צְפַרְדְּעִ֑ים בְּ֝חַדְרֵ֗י מַלְכֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
controles.kjv: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
controles.livre: A terra deles produziu rãs em abundância, até nos quartos de seus reis.

versos.hebraico: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א עָרֹ֑ב כִּ֝נִּ֗ים בְּכָל־גְּבוּלָֽם׃

controles.web: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
controles.kjv: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
controles.livre: Ele falou, e vieram vários bichos e piolhos em todos os seus limites.

versos.hebraico: נָתַ֣ן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶ֣ם בָּרָ֑ד אֵ֖שׁ לֶהָב֣וֹת בְּאַרְצָֽם׃

controles.web: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
controles.kjv: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
controles.livre: Tornou suas chuvas em saraiva; pôs fogo ardente em sua terra.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣ךְ גַּ֭פְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָ֑ם וַ֝יְשַׁבֵּ֗ר עֵ֣ץ גְּבוּלָֽם׃

controles.web: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
controles.kjv: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
controles.livre: E feriu suas vinhas e seus figueirais; e quebrou as árvores de seus territórios.

versos.hebraico: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א אַרְבֶּ֑ה וְ֝יֶ֗לֶק וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃

controles.web: He spoke, and the locusts came, and the grasshoppers, without number,
controles.kjv: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
controles.livre: Ele falou, e vieram gafanhotos, e incontáveis pulgões;

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אכַל כָּל־עֵ֣שֶׂב בְּאַרְצָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗אכַל פְּרִ֣י אַדְמָתָֽם׃

controles.web: ate up every plant in their land; and ate up the fruit of their ground.
controles.kjv: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
controles.livre: E comeram toda a erva de sua terra; e devoraram o fruto de seus campos.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣ךְ כָּל־בְּכ֣וֹר בְּאַרְצָ֑ם רֵ֝אשִׁ֗ית לְכָל־אוֹנָֽם׃

controles.web: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
controles.kjv: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
controles.livre: Também feriu a todos os primogênitos em sua terra; os primeiros de todas as suas forças.

versos.hebraico: וַֽ֭יּוֹצִיאֵם בְּכֶ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב וְאֵ֖ין בִּשְׁבָטָ֣יו כּוֹשֵֽׁל׃

controles.web: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
controles.kjv: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
controles.livre: E os tirou dali com prata e ouro; e dentre suas tribos não houve quem tropeçasse.

versos.hebraico: שָׂמַ֣ח מִצְרַ֣יִם בְּצֵאתָ֑ם כִּֽי־נָפַ֖ל פַּחְדָּ֣ם עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
controles.kjv: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
controles.livre: Até o Egito se alegrou com a saída deles, porque seu temor tinha caído sobre eles.

versos.hebraico: פָּרַ֣שׂ עָנָ֣ן לְמָסָ֑ךְ וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ לְהָאִ֥יר לָֽיְלָה׃

controles.web: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
controles.kjv: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
controles.livre: Ele estendeu uma nuvem como cobertor, e um fogo para iluminar a noite.

versos.hebraico: שָׁאַ֣ל וַיָּבֵ֣א שְׂלָ֑ו וְלֶ֥חֶם שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽם׃

controles.web: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
controles.kjv: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
controles.livre: Eles pediram, e fez vir codornizes; e os fartou com pão do céu.

versos.hebraico: פָּ֣תַח צ֭וּר וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מָ֑יִם הָ֝לְכ֗וּ בַּצִּיּ֥וֹת נָהָֽר׃

controles.web: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
controles.kjv: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
controles.livre: Ele abriu uma rocha, e dela saíram águas; e correram como um rio pelos lugares secos;

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־זָ֭כַר אֶת־דְּבַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ אֶֽת־אַבְרָהָ֥ם עַבְדּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
controles.kjv: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
controles.livre: Porque se lembrou de sua santa palavra, e de seu servo Abraão.

versos.hebraico: וַיּוֹצִ֣א עַמּ֣וֹ בְשָׂשׂ֑וֹן בְּ֝רִנָּ֗ה אֶת־בְּחִירָֽיו׃

controles.web: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
controles.kjv: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
controles.livre: Então ele tirou dali a seu povo com alegria; e seus eleitos com celebração.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם אַרְצ֣וֹת גּוֹיִ֑ם וַעֲמַ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֣ים יִירָֽשׁוּ׃

controles.web: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
controles.kjv: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
controles.livre: E lhes deu as terras das nações; e do trabalho das nações tomaram posse;

versos.hebraico: בַּעֲב֤וּר׀ יִשְׁמְר֣וּ חֻ֭קָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָ֥יו יִנְצֹ֗רוּ הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

controles.web: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!
controles.kjv: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the Lord.
